shared_elements: bearded male with elaborately curled hair/beard
low-relief carved figures with detailed patterned surface textures
figures shown walking/striding in procession or forward stance
justification: Both show low-relief bearded male figures in strict profile with tightly stylised curled hair and beards, patterned garments, raised gesturing hands and rosette/disc motifs, rendered with the same convention of flat planes overlaid with dense incised texture. The biggest difference in content is that A is a horizontal procession scene of attendants leading horned rams beside a stylised tree, framed by rosette borders, while B is a single large winged supernatural figure filling the whole panel with attributes in each hand and no animals or landscape.
